smoke.note: Development loop. Small enough to run between edits; exercises every code path the full profile does, just fewer times.

smoke120.note: The top of the supported rate band, at smoke size. 120fps is where the frame-rate assumptions bite: a frame is 8.3ms, the bake rate follows the project instead of sitting at 60Hz, and the zoom ceiling doubles. Same length as `smoke`, so it renders twice the frames.

full.note: The headline spec: 5 minutes, 18000 frames, 1080p60. This is the profile the stress test exists for.

extreme.note: Limit test. 4K raw frames are 33MB each, which halves the in-flight window (see features/export/frames.ts inFlightWindow). Run by hand.
